evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented opposition appeals to self-origination (autonomy) and positions ownership as a standing good (self-enhancement).

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Framing perspective as a kept asset appeals to self-origination (autonomy) and the durable mastery that perspective represents (competence).

mints.name: OwnershipAsValueDistinction
mints.title: owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence
mints.frame: Is the expression drawing a value distinction between what is owned and what is rented, positioning ownership as the appealed-to good?
